---
title: "Selamat Datang,"
title-block-banner: true  # Enable title block banner
description: "Terokai idea, analisis, dan kajian saya di sini."
header-includes:
    - |
      <style>
      #projects .quarto-listing-table tbody tr {
      counter-increment: row-counter;
      }
      #projects .quarto-listing-table tbody tr td:first-child::before {
      content: "[" counter(row-counter) "] ";
      }
      /* Column Widths */
      #projects .quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(1),  /* Tajuk */
      #projects .quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(1) {
        width: 5%;
      }

      #projects .quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(2),  /* Penerangan */
      #projects .quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(2) {
        width: 40%;
      }

      #projects .quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(3),  /* Tarikh */
      #projects .quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) {
        width: 42%;
      }
      .quarto-listing-category .category[data-category="Computational Physics Project"],
      .quarto-listing-category .category[data-category="Education"],
      .quarto-listing-category .category[data-category="Pure Physics Project"],
      .quarto-listing-category .category[data-category="Q.E.D."]{
        display: none !important;
      }
      
      #blog .listing-description {
      width: 70%;
      }
      .metadata {
      position: absolute;
      }
      
      /* Disable styles for mobile screens (width < 768px) */
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        #blog .listing-description {
          width: auto; /* Reset to default width */
        }
        .metadata {
          position: static; /* Reset to default positioning */
        }
      }
      </style>
      
listing:
  - id: blog 
    contents: 
      - blog
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    categories: unnumbered
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    feed: true
    fields: [title, description, date, reading-time]
    page-size: 5
    
  - id: project
    contents:
      - projects
    type: table
    fields: [Num,title, description, date, status]
    field-display-names:
      Num: "No"
      title: "Title"
      description: "Description"
      date: "Publish Date"
    max-description-length: 100
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    
include-after-body: "includes/footer.html"
page-layout: full
---
